name: Survey the empty plot
description: Mark the rectangular residential plot, street edge, north direction and building setbacks.

name: Remove debris and scrub
description: Clear loose rubble, weeds and construction waste from the building footprint.

name: Level and compact the soil
description: Grade the soil and compact the ground ready for the foundations.

name: Excavate foundation trenches
description: Excavate stepped trenches beneath the load-bearing walls and column grid.

name: Lay the PCC blinding course
description: Place a level plain-concrete bed at the bottom of each foundation trench.

name: Fix footing reinforcement
description: Position tied steel reinforcement cages with concrete cover spacers.

name: Cast reinforced concrete footings
description: Pour and cure the stepped reinforced footings below every column.

name: Build the plinth beam
description: Connect the footings with a continuous reinforced-concrete plinth beam.

name: Backfill and compact inside plinth
description: Return selected soil in compacted layers inside the completed plinth.

name: Cast the ground floor base
description: Lay damp-proofing and a compacted concrete ground-floor base slab.

name: Set ground-floor column starters
description: Anchor vertical steel starter bars at each structural column location.

name: Erect ground-floor column forms
description: Set accurately braced shuttering around the reinforced column cages.

name: Cast ground-floor columns
description: Pour concrete columns and reveal the first storey structural frame.

name: Form ground-floor beams
description: Install beam reinforcement and shuttering between the concrete columns.

name: Cast ground-floor ring beams
description: Pour the beams that tie the ground-floor frame together.

name: Install slab centering
description: Brace slab formwork at the correct level over the ground floor.

name: Place upper slab reinforcement
description: Tie the two-way steel mesh and extra bars at beam supports.

name: Cast the first-floor slab
description: Pour the reinforced-concrete slab that forms the first-floor ceiling.

name: Cure the first-floor slab
description: Keep the slab supported and curing before loading the next storey.

name: Build ground-floor brick walls
description: Lay the exterior brick courses around the ground-floor room plan.

name: Form the entry and room openings
description: Set lintels and accurate openings for the front door and internal doors.

name: Build the living-room wall returns
description: Complete the front living-room masonry and its projecting facade returns.

name: Build kitchen and utility walls
description: Lay the kitchen perimeter and a ventilated utility-room partition.

name: Build ground-floor partitions
description: Shape the bedroom, stair hall and service-room interior partitions.

name: Form the reinforced staircase
description: Cast the dog-leg concrete stair flights and intermediate landing.

name: Fix upper-storey column reinforcement
description: Tie the upper column cages into their starter bars above the first-floor slab.

name: Set upper-storey column formwork
description: Brace the upper column shutters plumb and aligned with the frame.

name: Cast upper-storey columns
description: Pour the second-storey columns above the ground-floor structure.

name: Form upper-storey beams
description: Install reinforced beam cages and shuttering around the upper perimeter.

name: Cast the roof-level beams
description: Connect the upper columns with the reinforced roof ring beam.

name: Lay roof slab centering
description: Brace and level the roof slab formwork above the upper storey.

name: Tie roof slab steel
description: Place roof reinforcement and anchorage bars for the parapet.

name: Cast the reinforced roof slab
description: Pour the flat concrete terrace roof of the two-storey home.

name: Build the upper-floor brick walls
description: Lay exterior masonry around the bedrooms and upper lounge.

name: Build upper-floor room partitions
description: Form bedroom, bathroom and landing partitions to the floor plan.

name: Install upper lintels and sills
description: Fit reinforced lintels and projecting masonry sills over openings.

name: Build the terrace parapet
description: Raise the roof-edge parapet wall and define the terrace boundary.

name: Install roof rainwater outlets
description: Set terrace outlets and downpipe sleeves to drain monsoon rain.

name: Apply terrace waterproofing
description: Seal the roof slab and turn waterproofing up at parapet joints.

name: Add roof heat-insulation screed
description: Lay sloped insulating screed that protects rooms from roof heat.

name: Set aluminium window frames
description: Anchor powder-coated aluminium frames in the ground-floor openings.

name: Glaze ground-floor windows
description: Fit clear insulated glazing with realistic reflective glass panes.

name: Fit the main teak entry door
description: Hang the broad timber entry door with frame, threshold and hardware.

name: Fit internal door frames
description: Install room and bathroom door frames through both storeys.

name: Run electrical conduits
description: Route concealed conduits, switch boxes and light circuits through rooms.

name: Install plumbing and drainage
description: Route water supply, soil stacks and floor-drain connections to wet rooms.

name: Add bathroom waterproofing
description: Seal bathroom floors and shower walls before tile installation.

name: Plaster ground-floor interiors
description: Apply smooth cement plaster to ground-floor room walls and ceilings.

name: Plaster upper-floor interiors
description: Level the upper rooms, landing and stairwell with interior plaster.

name: Screed the ground-floor rooms
description: Level the living, kitchen and bedroom floors for final finishes.

name: Lay ground-floor stone flooring
description: Install large-format warm stone tiles through the living spaces.

name: Tile the upper-floor bedrooms
description: Lay timber-look porcelain flooring in the bedrooms and upper lounge.

name: Tile bathroom floors and walls
description: Set durable stone tile and a contrasting shower-wall finish.

name: Grout and seal floor finishes
description: Grout tile joints and seal exposed stone surfaces across the house.

name: Apply exterior base plaster
description: Cover exposed exterior brickwork with an even cement render coat.

name: Shape facade bands and reveals
description: Form recessed window reveals and clean horizontal facade bands.

name: Install facade stone cladding
description: Apply textured local stone panels to the entrance feature wall.

name: Paint the exterior warm ivory
description: Prime and paint the rendered walls in a contemporary ivory tone.

name: Add charcoal facade accents
description: Paint balcony edges and architectural bands in deep charcoal grey.

name: Install the first-floor balcony slab
description: Extend a reinforced balcony cantilever from the upper living room.

name: Fit balcony glass balustrade
description: Fix tempered-glass panels and stainless steel handrail to the balcony.

name: Set upper-floor aluminium frames
description: Install matching window frames at the second-storey openings.

name: Glaze the upper-floor windows
description: Fit reflective glazing to bedrooms and the balcony door.

name: Hang upper-floor doors
description: Install finished timber doors for bedrooms and bathrooms upstairs.

name: Build timber stair treads
description: Finish the concrete stair with warm timber treads and nosings.

name: Install the stair handrail
description: Anchor a slim timber and dark-metal balustrade along the stair.

name: Fit kitchen worktops
description: Install a dark granite worktop over the lower kitchen cabinets.

name: Install built-in kitchen cabinets
description: Fit warm wood lower cabinets and light upper cabinets to the kitchen.

name: Fit bathroom sanitaryware
description: Install toilets, basins, showers and chrome mixer fittings.

name: Fit electrical switches and sockets
description: Finish outlet plates, switchgear and safe distribution-board details.

name: Install recessed ceiling lights
description: Fit warm recessed downlights in the ceiling soffits and rooms.

name: Install facade wall lights
description: Mount weatherproof up-down lights on the front facade columns.

name: Fit balcony soffit lighting
description: Add discreet warm lighting beneath the first-floor balcony.

name: Install exterior rainwater pipes
description: Connect terrace outlets to finished downpipes on the side walls.

name: Fit AC ledges and service screens
description: Add ventilated service ledges that conceal exterior equipment.

name: Install window shades
description: Add slim exterior sunshades above exposed south-facing windows.

name: Finish the terrace walking surface
description: Lay non-slip terrace pavers around the roof access stairhead.

name: Add terrace access stairhead
description: Build and finish the small stair enclosure opening onto the terrace.

name: Install terrace metal safety rail
description: Fit a dark powder-coated rail along the safe terrace edge.

name: Complete the facade reveal details
description: Seal joints, clean glazing and finish visible exterior edges and trims.

name: Cast the front boundary wall
description: Build a rendered compound wall along the street and plot sides.

name: Fit the sliding main gate
description: Install a contemporary slatted metal vehicle gate at the entrance.

name: Lay the driveway sub-base
description: Compact aggregate from the street gate to the covered entry.

name: Pave the stone driveway
description: Lay patterned charcoal and pale stone pavers across the driveway.

name: Build the pedestrian entry path
description: Pave a separate walkway with broad natural-stone stepping slabs.

name: Prepare the garden planting beds
description: Shape planting beds along the boundary and front facade.

name: Lay the front lawn
description: Install a neat green lawn and define its edges with stone borders.

name: Plant Indian shade trees
description: Plant young frangipani and native shade trees within the front garden.

name: Add shrubs and tropical planting
description: Fill garden beds with layered shrubs, grasses and flowering plants.

name: Install gate and garden lights
description: Add warm bollard lights along the entry path and boundary gate.

name: Furnish the living room
description: Place a modern sofa, timber coffee table and neutral woven rug.

name: Add the living-room media wall
description: Install a low media console, display niches and wall-mounted screen.

name: Furnish the ground-floor bedroom
description: Place a double bed, side tables and wardrobe in the guest bedroom.

name: Furnish the upper master bedroom
description: Add a king bed, bedside lamps, soft linen and a fitted wardrobe.

name: Fit the dining room
description: Set a solid-wood dining table with chairs near the kitchen.

name: Complete kitchen appliances
description: Install the refrigerator, cooktop, oven and extractor hood.

name: Add curtains and interior decor
description: Hang linen curtains and place restrained art and decorative objects.

name: Furnish the balcony
description: Place outdoor chairs, a small table and planters on the balcony.

name: Complete final cleaning and inspection
description: Clean glazing, polish floors and inspect the finished rooms and site.

name: Open the completed residence
description: Finish the handover details and reveal the fully furnished modern Indian home.
